Title: NETMESSAGE:Congratulations you defeated the fire monster!
Translation: 恭喜你击败了火焰怪物！

Title: NETMESSAGE:I better climb these crates and go over this pipe...
Translation: 我最好爬上这些板条箱，越过这根管道...

Title: NETMESSAGE:You've reached the end of level 1! \n\nNext level is Sectore_2
Translation: 你已到达第一关的终点！\n\n下一关是Sectore_2

Title: NETMESSAGE:You looking for Freeman?\nI heard he's headed towards the Lambda Complex.
Translation: 你在找弗里曼吗？\n我听说他正前往拉姆达复合体。

Translation: 你最好在我之前找到他，那个狗娘养的杀了我半个小队。

Translation: 恭喜你击败了玻璃怪物！\n\n 你是赢家！

Translation: 所有5朵奇花都已收集！你是赢家！

Title: NETMESSAGE:A freaky flower has been acquired!
NETMESSAGE:You broke all the glass windows on the map!
Translation: 你打碎了地图上所有的玻璃窗！
